episodes.title: Ex-Cult Insider: How Narcissists TRAP You & How to ESCAPE | Mark Vicente
episodes.description:
Mark Vicente spent 12 years inside NXIVM before he realised the man he called his mentor was a malignant narcissist. He's the filmmaker behind What the Bleep Do We Know!?, the whistleblower whose story was told in HBO's The Vow, and now the director of Narcissist's Playbook, a documentary that sits down with self-confessed narcissists to expose how they think and how they trap people.

We talk about how narcissists and cult leaders study you before they ever make a move, why the people who say they'd never fall for it are the easiest targets, and why "just leave" is never that simple. Mark opens up about the moment it all cracked, how he found his way back to himself, and the one thing narcissists can't stand that can help you break free.

"It's not physical chains, it's emotional chains."

🎬 WATCH NARCISSIST'S PLAYBOOK
After leaving the cult, Mark set out to understand what he had missed. He sat down with self-confessed narcissists to learn how they think, what they feel and what they don't, alongside survivors who share what it took to get out. If you've ever asked yourself how you didn't see it, this film is for you.
Rent it now: https://www.narcissistsplaybook.com
In-person screenings: Cape Town on 25 November, with Johannesburg and more cities coming. Details on the website.
